Holding priority, activate Pyrohemia by paying {R}, dealing 1 damage to each creature and player.
The Incredible Hulk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, untapping it and giving you an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
4629-7067-7124.notes: If desired, you can use the remaining {R} to activate Pyrohemia more times and stack combat phases. You can also use that mana to put charge counters on Fire Nation Turret. As you repeat step 1 each time, The Incredible Hulk will gain another instance of firebending 2, which will trigger separately, adding an additional {R}{R} each loop.

Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing both Su-Chi Cave Guards, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guards die, they trigger, adding 16 {C}.
Activate the token Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Scarecrone from your graveyard to the battlefield.
